overlapCandidates.title: David’s gift to each person: “a flagon of wine”, or a cake from the pan?
overlapCandidates.summary: After the ark is brought in, the KJV has David give everyone bread, flesh and “a flagon of wine”. The Greek has no wine: the third gift is a cake from the frying-pan.

overlapCandidates.title: At the pool of Samaria: “they washed his armour”, or the harlots washed?
overlapCandidates.summary: After Ahab’s death the KJV says “they washed his armour”. The Hebrew says the harlots washed, and the Greek says the harlots washed themselves in the blood.
